pony_trekker.text: The ponies in these hills are semi-wild. Welsh Mountain ponies. They're tougher than me and better at hills.
I tried to ride one once. It just stood there until I got off. Boss behaviour.

stargazer.text: This is an International Dark Sky Reserve. On a clear night you can see the Milky Way. On a normal night, my umbrella.
Since 2013, they've been very strict about streetlights. The sheep don't mind.

storey_instructor.text: Storey Arms started as a coaching inn. Now it's an outdoor centre. Kids come to learn about the hills.
I teach 'Don't Wear Cotton'. Everyone remembers it by lunch. Usually in the bog.

shepherd.text: Pen y Fan is the highest point in southern Britain. Eight hundred and eighty-six metres.
Soldiers train on these hills. Fan Dance, they call it. I just call it Tuesday with sheep.

lost_walker.text: Which way is Cardiff? South, everyone says. The mist says 'upwards' and 'maybe'.
I've been on this path three hours. It's about forty metres long. I'm very thorough.

fete_bog_steward.text: Flippers, mask and snorkel, along a trench cut through a peat bog, there and back. Press Confirm to kick on the beat, and Up when a breath is marked.
No swimming strokes are allowed, only the flippers. Keep it tidy and keep it under the time.
The real thing: the August bank holiday weekend, Saturday to Monday. Any other day I run it for pocket money.
